findings.finding: The apply test 'a mutation with both add and remove of one name writes it as added only' is only true when the name is NOT already in the ticket's current releases. In the body the plan extracts, the no-op filter keeps an add only if the name is absent and a remove only if it is present, and the added∩removed dedup runs after that filter. So when the name is already present, the add is dropped as a no-op, the remove survives, and the shared `_apply_inbound_list_delta` writes `removed=[name]`, which contradicts 'added only'. The plan does not state the precondition, so the test could be written against a present name and then either fail or push the implementer to change the shared labels logic, breaking the 'labels unchanged' requirement.
